fields.text: Deposits, No-Show Fees and Reminders: What 179,700 Appointments Show Clinics

Should a clinic charge a no-show fee or take a deposit, and will either drive patients away? This session answers with counts. Across 179,700 appointments at 1,240 small clinics, salons and studios from January to June 2026, bookings with a deposit were no-shows 2.7% of the time, against 7.6% without one. Two reminders, sent 24 hours and 2 hours before, went with 3.7%, against 6.4% for one reminder. Front desk managers will leave with a deposit or fee rule they can explain to patients, and a reminder schedule they can turn on the following week.

I'm Dana Example, co-founder and head of customer success at Example Booking Software. I have helped 1,240 clinics, salons and studios set up online booking, deposits and reminders, and I ran a salon front desk for six years before that. I spoke on reminders at the Example Salon Owners Meetup in April 2026.

fields.text: Deposit or No-Show Fee? What 179,700 Bookings Say About Empty Chairs

Should you charge a no-show fee or take a deposit, and will clients walk away if you do? Salon owners ask this more than any other no-show question, and most answer it with a guess. This session answers it with counts. Across 179,700 appointments booked at 1,240 small service businesses from January to June 2026, bookings that took a deposit were no-shows 2.7% of the time, against 7.6% for bookings without one. Two reminders, sent 24 hours and 2 hours before, went with a 3.7% no-show rate, against 6.4% for a single reminder. You will leave with a deposit amount you can defend to new clients, a reminder schedule you can switch on that week, and a written policy your front desk can hold to.

Dana Example is co-founder and head of customer success at Example Booking Software, where she has helped 1,240 salons, clinics and studios set up online booking, deposits and reminders. Before that she ran the front desk of a three-chair salon for six years. She spoke on reminders at the Example Salon Owners Meetup in April 2026.

Find the appointment types that lose the most chairs to no-shows and fix those first
Schedule reminders by count and timing so clients confirm instead of tuning out
